title: Durable workflow with Inngest
description: Run a minimal multi-step workflow with retries and a durable sleep on Neon Functions, and store job state in Lakebase Postgres.

environment.name: INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: Inngest signs its requests to /api/inngest with this key. Find it in Inngest Cloud by opening Apps and choosing Sync new app.

environment.name: INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
environment.description: The function sends app/job.created events to Inngest with this key. Find it in Inngest Cloud on the Keys page under Manage.
